checklist.notes: The activities consolidate present-versus-past time reference and requests involving personal information, then integrate these in speaking and writing.
Time clues, an ordered model exchange, correction feedback, and clear rubrics make the targets learnable.
Controlled matching, ordering, and correction precede the more open speaking and writing tasks.
Directions specify fictional personal data and exact output constraints, reducing privacy and task ambiguity.
Each controlled task isolates one choice before the final two-sentence contrast.
Names and practical form-filling situations are locally relatable, while explicit tense markers support cross-linguistic noticing.
Five brief activities culminating in two sentences are an appropriate compact workload.
